NONE: › without any worry about possible criticism or embarrassment
不怕批評的；不害臊的；不難爲情的

example: She is to this day unabashed in her patriotism.
她到現在還敢於表達自己的愛國主義立場。
He is an unabashed capitalist.
他是一個厚臉皮的資本家。
Compare
abashed

NONE: › without becoming weaker in strength or force
未減弱的；不鬆勁的；勢頭不減的

example: The fighting continued unabated throughout the night.
整個晚上戰鬥一直很激烈。
Compare
abate

NONE: B1 to not be able to do something
不能做，無法做

example: We were unable to contact him at the time.
我們當時無法和他取得聯繫。

NONE: › An unabridged book, speech, or article is in its original form and has not been made shorter.
（書、講話或文章）未刪節的，完整的
› spoken without any accent (= the way people from a particular country or area pronounce words)
說話不帶（地方）口音的

example: He speaks perfect unaccented English.
他說英語一點沒有口音。

NONE: B2 too bad to be accepted, approved of, or allowed to continue
不能接受（或同意、允許）的

example: The teachers' union has described the latest pay offer as unacceptable.
工會稱最新的工資提議無法接受。
The taking of hostages, said the president, was totally unacceptable under any circumstances.
總統表示，無論在甚麽情況下劫持人質都是不能容忍的。
The report found what it described as "unacceptable levels of air pollution" in several major cities.
在幾個大城市裡都出現了這份報告所表述的「難以忍受的空氣污染狀況」。

NONE: › in a way that cannot be accepted, approved of, or allowed to continue
不能接受（或同意、允許）地
› not having anyone with you when you go somewhere
無人陪伴的，獨自出行的
› Unaccompanied music is produced by a singer or by someone playing a musical instrument without anyone else singing or playing at the same time.
（音樂）無伴奏的

example: To everyone's great surprise, the princess arrived at the ball unaccompanied.
令所有人都大吃一驚的是，公主獨自一人來參加舞會。
She sang the first three verses with a piano and the last verse unaccompanied.
她在鋼琴的伴奏下唱了前三節，清唱了最後一節。

NONE: › to not be expected to explain or provide a reason to a particular person or organization for your actions
無須對…作出解釋；不必對…負責
› not able to be explained or understood
難以解釋的；無法理解的

example: The military and CIA hire contractors who are completely unaccountable to Congress.
軍方和中央情報局雇傭承包商，這些人的行為完全不必對國會負責。
an unaccountable and inefficient bureacracy
不負責且效率低下的官僚體系
For some unaccountable reason, he keeps his wallet in his underwear drawer.
不知何故，他把錢包放在內衣抽屜裡。

NONE: › If a person is unaccounted for, it is not known where they are or whether they are still alive.
（某人）生死未知的
› If something such as an amount of money is unaccounted for, it is not present and there is no explanation for what has happened to it.
（金錢）找不到的，去向不明的

example: A fire on the ship killed a hundred or more passengers - some likely victims are still unaccounted for.
船上的大火讓一百多名乘客喪生，可能還有些人生死未知。
An audit of the police department found that $100,000 in cash and one handgun were unaccounted for.
對警察局進行的審計發現有10萬美元現金和一支手槍去向不明。

after verb: › [ after verb ] not familiar with something, or not used to something

example: The weather presented a particular challenge, especially for soldiers unaccustomed to subarctic conditions.
這種天氣尤其對不適應亞北極地區氣候的軍人提出了特別的挑戰。
The Olympic and world champion finished in the unaccustomed position of fourth.
這位奧運會冠軍和世界冠軍表現失常，最後僅僅獲得了第四名。
Opposite
accustomed

NONE: › not spoiled or made weaker by the addition of other substances; pure
不摻雜質的，純的

example: People injecting drugs can never be sure that they're using unadulterated substances.
注射毒品的人永遠無法確定他們用的是否爲純品。
a feeling of unadulterated joy
無盡的喜悅感

NONE: C2 not influenced, harmed, or interrupted in any way
未受影響的；未受傷害的；未被打斷的
› approving natural and sincere in your behaviour
真誠自然的；不矯揉造作的；真摯的

example: The west of the city was largely unaffected by the bombing.
該城西部基本上沒有受到轟炸的破壞。
Flights out of most major airports were unaffected by the snow.
大多數主要城市的離港航班沒有受到大雪的影響。
For someone who has spent 40 years in show business she seems relatively unaffected by it all.
作爲一個在娛樂圈了做了40年的人，她仍然保持著驚人的純真。

NONE: C1 too expensive for people to be able to buy or pay for
支付不起的

example: For many people, this type of treatment remains unaffordable.
許多人支付不起這種治療方法。

NONE: › without any help from anyone else; independently
無外援的；獨立的

example: Since his accident, he hasn't been able to walk unaided.
自從出了車禍後，他一直不能獨自行走。
The two explorers attempted an unaided walk across the South Pole.
兩位探險者試圖獨自徒步穿越南極點。

NONE: inalienable
› (especially of a positive feeling) not spoiled by any amount of negative feeling; pure
（尤指積極的情感）純真的，純粹的

example: Spending time with one's family is never an unalloyed pleasure (= there are bad things about it too).
和家人在一起時從來不會只有快樂、沒有煩惱。
We had the perfect holiday - two weeks of unalloyed bliss.
我們度過了完美的假期——兩週逍遙快活的時光。

NONE: › expressed in a way that makes it completely clear what is meant
不含糊的，明確的

example: The minister promised a clear and unambiguous statement on the future of the coal industry.
部長稱她將儘快就煤炭工業的前途問題作一個清楚明確的表示。

NONE: › the state of being unanimous
全體一致；意見一致
C2 If a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about one particular matter or vote the same way, and if a decision or judgment is unanimous, it is formed or supported by everyone in a group.
（團體）意見一致的；（決定或裁決）一致通過的，獲得全體支援的

example: The jury returned a unanimous verdict of guilty after a short deliberation.
陪審團經過短時間商討後一致裁決有罪。
After a lengthy discussion we reached a unanimous decision on the proposal.
經過長時間討論，我們對這一提案作出了一致決定。
The new format has unanimous support.
新的形式獲得了一致支持。

NONE: › If someone arrives unannounced, they arrive suddenly and unexpectedly.
（某人的到來）未通知的（地），未打招呼的（地）；突然的（地）
› not made publicly known
未宣佈的，未公佈的

example: She appeared unannounced and took control of the meeting.
她突然出現並控制了會議。
The Texan singer will be supported by two other bands, as yet unannounced.
這位德克薩斯歌手將由另外兩支樂隊伴奏，但還沒公佈是哪兩支樂隊。

NONE: › formal If an argument or claim is unanswerable, people cannot disagree with it because it is so clearly true.
（論點或說法）無可爭辯的，不容反對的
› (of a question) without an answer
（問題）沒有答案的，無法回答的

example: In economic terms the need to reduce inflation is unanswerable.
從經濟學角度考慮，需要降低通貨膨脹是毋庸置疑的。
As to how long this war will last, it's an unanswerable question.
至於這場戰爭會持續多久，沒有人知道答案。

NONE: › not answered or explained
未得到回答（或解釋）的

example: Questions from local residents remained unanswered.
當地居民提出的問題仍然沒有得到答覆。

NONE: › not attractive or interesting
不吸引人的；無趣的
› not showing that you understand how good something is, or not grateful for something
不欣賞的；不賞識的；不感激的；不領情的
› Someone who is unapproachable seems unfriendly or a little frightening, so that other people are less likely to speak to them.
（人）不友好的，難以接近的，令人敬而遠之的

example: As a boss I found him rather unapproachable.
作爲老闆，我發現他有點兒難以接近。

NONE: › not able to be argued
無可爭辯的，不容置疑的
› not armed
徒手的，不帶武器的；非武裝的
› not ashamed; without hiding behaviour or opinions that other people might consider unacceptable
不知羞恥的，不害臊的；無顧忌的

example: Afterwards he spent five minutes with the president, of whom he is an unashamed admirer.
之後他與自己狂熱崇拜的總統在一起了五分鐘時間。
We then checked into the hotel for a weekend of unashamed luxury.
我們隨後入住旅館，無所顧忌地享受了一個奢侈週末。

NONE: › in such a strong position that you cannot be defeated
不可戰勝的
› impossible to doubt or argue with
無可辯駁的；無懈可擊的
› impossible to attack
固若金湯的；不能攻克的

example: This win has given the team an unassailable lead.
結果使這支球隊遙遙領先。
The president looked unassailable with over 60 percent of the vote.
總統以高於百分之60的選票獲得絕對優勢。
The conclusions were unassailable.
這些結論無懈可擊。
an unassailable fortress
固若金湯的要塞

NONE: › without being helped by anyone or anything
沒有任何（人）幫助的

example: She decided on an unassisted birth at home.
她決定在家生孩子，沒有任何人幫助。

NONE: › Someone who is unassuming is quiet and shows no wish for attention or admiration
（人）不愛出風頭的，謙遜的

example: He was shy and unassuming and not at all how you expect an actor to be.
他靦腆低調，一點兒也不像你想像中的演員的樣子。

NONE: › not married or not having a relationship with anyone; single
未婚的，單身的；未戀愛的
› not physically joined to something else
無聯繫的；未連接的
› not feeling connected to a person, group, or idea
不覺得與（人，團體，理念）有任何關聯的

example: He's gorgeous, he has his own house and, what's more, he's unattached.
他儀錶堂堂，有自己的房子，而且還是單身。
The cover of the book was stained and almost completely unattached.
書的封面弄髒了而且幾乎掉了下來。
Feeling unattached to the community is one of the risk factors for drug abuse.
與周圍社區沒有任何聯繫是造成使用毒品的風險之一。

NONE: C2 not able to be achieved
達不到的，無法實現的

example: an unattainable ideal
無法實現的理想
Many economists think that full employment is an unattainable goal.
一些經濟學家認為實現充分就業的目標是無法達到的。

NONE: › not being watched or taken care of
無人看管的；無人照料的

example: Please do not leave your luggage unattended.
請不要丟下您的行李無人照管。
According to the report, most accidents occur when young children are left unattended in the home.
根據報告，大多數事故發生在孩子被獨自留在家裡的時候。

NONE: B2 unpleasant to look at
難看的，不漂亮的
C1 lacking good or positive features
不好的，糟糕的；乏味的

example: This is modern architecture at its most unattractive.
這是現代建築最醜陋之處。
He was short and overweight and generally unattractive.
他又矮又胖，整個人看上去很難看。
All of the options were equally unattractive.
這些選擇都很糟。

NONE: › without someone's official permission to do something or be in a particular place
未經授權的，未經許可的

example: Unauthorized personnel are not admitted beyond this point.
未經許可，不得進入。
This unauthorized biography of the star has sold over 10,000 copies in its first week in print.
這本未經授權的明星傳記刊印後第一個星期就賣出了一萬多本。

after verb: C1 [ after verb ] If someone is unavailable, they are not able to talk to people or meet people, usually because they are doing other things.
（通常指某人忙於他事而）不能會面的，不能交談的，抽不開身的
B2 If something is unavailable, you cannot get it or use it.

example: News outlets tried to contact the Senator, but she was unavailable for comment.
新聞機構試圖聯繫參議員，但是她無暇發表評論。
This information was previously unavailable to the public.
這樣的資訊以前公眾是無法獲知的。

NONE: › When an attempt to do something is unavailing, it is unsuccessful or has no positive effect.
徒勞的，無成果的

example: Diplomatic efforts at peace-making have so far proved unavailing.
調停爭端的外交努力到目前爲止被證明是徒勞的。

NONE: C1 impossible to avoid
無法避免的
B2 not understanding or realizing something
未意識到的，不知道的

example: [ + that ] He was unaware that the police were watching him.
他不知道警方在監視他。
I was completely unaware of the problem.
我根本沒意識到這個問題。

NONE: › suddenly and unexpectedly without any warning
出其不意地，意外地，冷不防地

example: The overnight invasion took the military experts unawares.
一夜間突然入侵令軍事專家們始料不及。
The government was obviously caught unawares by (= was not expecting) the criticism.
政府似乎對這突然發起的抨擊猝不及防。
